system_prompt_style.note: Version public-baseline-v0.5.16.4 matches arXiv:2607.08028 (enterprise contract harness); the HARNESS DOE paper (2511.10810) is a name collision and is not used for coding. Paper says 'The prompt is kept short and policy-oriented' but gives no construction mechanism; no repo in bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the live-LLM mode sends the same bounded claim package to a hosted model
env_context_strategy.note: Context is code-selected source-backed claims and wiki context injected up front, not vector retrieval; closest value is uncertain (could be read as a structured retrieval). Mismatch: claim selection is rule-based, scoped to company and claim type. Ambiguity candidate.

context_compaction.note: Single-shot composition; no history handling described; no repo available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the live-LLM mode sends the same bounded claim package to a hosted model
observation_format.note: Claims are JSON artifacts; exact presentation format to model not shown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Two live responses failed JSON-object parsing.
tool_call_format.evidence_locator: arXiv:2607.08028 paper App. A6 Table A6
tool_call_format.note: Model returns structured JSON answer, not tool calls; closest value.

tool_count.note: No model-facing tool list described; repo not in bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing system; no tool registry available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the control layer resolves the selected corporate group and company, collects filing, market, news, wiki, and claim context, builds an answer plan, generates the visible answer, validates the output contract, and records the trace.
loop_primitives.note: Deterministic fallback on invalid output described in Sec. 3.5.

planning_granularity.note: Answer plan is code-built (sections, follow-up filters), not model-maintained.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A live LLM may be attached at the composition boundary to phrase a structured answer

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: A human-in-the-loop mechanism allows subject matter experts (SMEs) to refine predictions
human_in_loop.note: The SMEs refine the outputs. The gating point is inferred from prose.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The process trace records tool and source states such as live, local, fallback, fixture, or error.

long_term_memory.note: Wiki pages are curated knowledge, not run-to-run memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Leakage checks block internal claim identifiers, raw trace records, API diagnostics, fixture labels, and internal-only status text from the reader-facing answer.
self_verification.note: Code-owned output-contract validators; closest value is linters_typecheck (schema/rule validation). Ambiguity candidate.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the live output is unavailable or invalid, the runtime falls back to the deterministic composer.
retry_policy.note: Fallback to deterministic composer instead of retry.

termination_condition.note: Single composition call; latency budget is a validation check, not termination.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: differ only in whether process-level caching and prewarming of the live source retrieval is enabled
cost_controls.note: Caching of source retrieval, not prompt caching.

tracing.evidence_quote: the trace instead records the requested model identifier, output-contract status, recovery path, final harness-contract result

replayability.evidence_quote: the deterministic composer described above provides the replayable baseline
replayability.note: Live-LLM runs stated not bit-for-bit reproducible (Sec. 7).

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The corresponding evaluator artifacts are stored in the repository’sevals/results/ directory
eval_hooks.note: Custom scenario evaluator, not a public benchmark.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Language checks enforce the insight-first answer structure and block recommendation-style phrasing such as buy, sell, or target-price instructions.
guardrails.note: Source gate / claim admission counted as action_policies (low).

target_domain.evidence_quote: the reconstruction of an LLM-based investment-briefing agent

open_source.note: Public repository stated but no licence in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It used OpenRouter as experimental routing infrastructure

primary_artifact.note: Repo exists but not in bundle; coded from paper.
